label: sorega
title: 其れが
meaning_example: We had heavy rains this morning due to the typhoon. Despite that, it suddenly started getting sunny this afternoon and now it's perfectly lovely outside.

notes.text: それが is very similar in meaning and usage to それなのに and にもかからわず。
notes.html: それが is very similar in meaning and usage to それなのに and にもかからわず。

notes.text: sore ga can also be used to indicate to your conversation partner that the answer to his/her question has a different/unexpected result.
notes.html: sore ga can also be used to indicate to your conversation partner that the answer to his/her question has a different/unexpected result.

examples.japanese: 朝は台風の影響で大雨でした。それが、昼前から急に晴れてきて、今はすっかり快晴だ。
examples.body_text:
朝は台風の影響で大雨でした。それが、昼前から急に晴れてきて、今はすっかり快晴だ。 

		We had heavy rains this morning due to the typhoon. 
		Despite that, 
		it suddenly started getting sunny this afternoon and now it's perfectly lovely outside.
